messages:
OncallBot: INCIDENT #7892 — detected partial degradation for /v1/generate across hosted-us-east-1 (error spike + latency increase). Severity: S2 -> monitoring. Auto-tag: #customer-impact. Links: https://incidents.redwood/7892 :rotating_light:
Sam M: Ack. I'm primary for this shift, taking ownership. Priya, can you be secondary?
Priya K: +1, I'm secondary. grabbing logs and will run quick golden-path checks.
Evan L: Any sign of retries/batch backlog? metrics look like 5xxs concentrated on 2 nodes?
Sam M: Yep, error-rate ~4.8% over the last 5m, p50 latency jumped from 60ms -> 340ms on hosted-us-east-1. Appears to correlate with a kernel upgrade on node pool rtx-ops-3 earlier today.
Priya K: Running `curl -s -D - -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://hosted-us-east-1.redwood/v1/generate` against a few endpoints now. Also tailing inference runtime logs: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime --tail=200`
Maria J: FYI I'm on a customer sync in 10, can cover the tail end if needed for 30m. If this escalates to S1, page infra leads immediately.
Sam M: Noted. For coverage gaps: I'm primary for the next 45m, then hand to Maria if still active. Priya to stay secondary. Evan, can you look at routing/traffic split and confirm fallbacks?
Evan L: Looking. Early signs: routing still sending 100% to a single nodegroup due to a mis-set affinity rule. Will attempt a quick reroute to amber-pool (low-risk) to cut load on rtx-ops-3.
Priya K: Quick triage commands I'm running (runbook snippet):
```
# golden-path checks
curl -sS -o /tmp/resp.json https://hosted-us-east-1.redwood/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
jq . /tmp/resp.json | head
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | egrep "rtx-ops-3|amber-pool"
kubectl -n inference describe pod <hot-pod> | egrep -i "oom|error|backpressure"
```
Priya K: Initial logs show repeated `CUDA out of memory` messages on 2 pods and kernel warnings in dmesg.
Theo R: Escalation check: if this crosses severity S1 (customer-impact large or >10% error-rate sustained 10m) -> page infra leads (pager: infra-leads), oncall-sre, and the duty director. If S2 continues >30m without mitigation -> expand page to model-ops.
Sam M: Copy. Escalation matrix (short):
```
S1: page infra-leads, oncall-sre, duty-director, schedule immediate bridge -> action: failover to amber-pool + emergency rollback of kernel
S2: page oncall + eng leads, notify product & success for customer comms, mitigation window 30m -> action: routing reroute + scaled up amber-pool
S3: monitor, ticket and normal biz-as-usual
```
Priya K: I'm going to cordon the two offending nodes, drain them and observe. Commands: `kubectl drain node/<node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then check readiness. Will annotate in the runbook.
Evan L: I pushed a temporary route rule to send 30% to amber-pool, keeping 70% on current. Error-rate dropped to 2.1% within 90s. p50 back to ~90ms.
OncallBot: UPDATE on INCIDENT #7892 — service error-rate improved to 1.9%, latency trending down. Tags: mitigated, monitoring.
Sam M: Good. We're in mitigation. Still keep runbook steps:
- Primary: coordinate reroute, decide on rollback if errors rise >3.5%
- Secondary: collect logs, start capture for postmortem (trace + full request sample set)
- If >= S1: page infra-leads and duty-director immediately

Sam M: Coverage note: Maria will take primary at 3524688200 if we still need coverage; Priya remains secondary. I'll update the shift handoff doc after this incident.
Maria J: I'm on standby to take over at the handoff, and will own customer comms if we hit S1.
Priya K: Captured log bundle and uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-incident-archives/7892/logbundle.tar.gz. Also started a short screen recording for the infra team.
Theo R: Minor reminder on paging etiquette: avoid paging infra-leads for transient blips under 5m unless customer-impact clear. Use oncall-sre first and include TL;DR of what you've tried.
Sam M: Agreed. Final for now: mitigation working, preparing brief postmortem template and scheduled a bridge if we reopen. If anyone sees new regression, call it out here and escalate per matrix. :thumbsup:
OncallBot: INCIDENT #7892 marked MONITORING -> RESOLVED at 3524684850 (auto-close after 30m stable).
Sam M: Closing notes: runbook ref: https://playbooks.redwood/oncall/runtime-degradation; follow-up owner: Priya K for logs/forensic, Eva (cc Evan L) to check affinity rules, Maria to do customer comms if needed. We'll sync tomorrow 10:30 for a 30m postmortem.
Theo R: Thanks team. Logged timeline and decision points in the incident doc.
Sam M: Handing off shadow notes to Maria now. Good job everyone. :raised_hands:
